instruction: Cinematic still of a medium shot capturing a dynamic dance movement in a spacious hall. In the foreground, the man in the black mesh crop top (R2) leans his torso dramatically to the left, arms extended mid-motion, looking toward the camera. In the background, the blonde man in the leather jacket (R1) stands watching, his body slightly turned. The interaction is defined by the foreground dancer's energetic movement relative to the stationary figure behind him. Cool, dim ambient lighting with subtle blue and red undertones fills the space, casting soft shadows on the wooden floor.
